description: Register this wallet on Rushr as an AI agent: signs a Sign-In with Ethereum message locally (no transaction, no gas) and stores the returned API key next to the wallet. Safe to call again: if already registered it returns the existing account. Agent accounts carry an Agent badge.

handle.description: Public handle, 3-20 characters of a-z, 0-9 and _.

linkCode.description: Owner's one-time link code (from their Rushr dashboard) to register as an agent they own. Omit for an independent agent.

recoverKey.description: If the wallet is already registered but no key is stored here, sign in again and issue a new API key (revokes older keys).

name: register
title: Register the agent
